test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient/necessary to answer the question.

**Question:**

What will be the total price of 10 chairs, each of which is of the same price?

**Statements:**

I. One-fourth of the price of each chair is ₹140.

II. The total price of 3 chairs is ₹560 more than the total price of 2 chairs.

options.text: Statement II alone is sufficient, while Statement I alone is not sufficient
Either Statement I or Statement II is sufficient
Both Statement I and Statement II are necessary
Statement I alone is sufficient, while Statement II alone is not sufficient

solution:
**Explanation:**

**Statements I: **One-fourth of the price of each chair is ₹140.

 
• This implies price of one chair =140 × 4 = 560
 
• Price of 10 chairs =560 × 10 = 5600
